title: Grandma's Healthy Recipe Preservation Book
problem: Healthy traditional foods like jowar roti and sesame laddus are being replaced by packaged fast foods in village households.
idea: A digital recipe book of grandma's healthy foods with simple cooking steps. Read the cards, check your own week's food, and try the quiz.

items.title: Jonna rotte (Jowar roti)
items.text: Made from jowar flour. Full of fibre and keeps you full for long.
items.te: జొన్న రొట్టె: పీచు ఎక్కువ, ఎక్కువసేపు ఆకలి వేయదు.

items.title: Nuvvula undalu (Sesame laddu)
items.text: Sesame and jaggery balls, made at Sankranti. Give calcium and iron.
items.te: నువ్వుల ఉండలు: సంక్రాంతికి చేస్తారు, కాల్షియం, ఐరన్ ఉంటాయి.

items.title: Ragi java (Ragi malt)
items.text: A drink from ragi (finger millet) flour. Very rich in calcium.

items.title: Sarva pindi
items.text: A Telangana rice-flour pancake with chana dal, peanuts and green chillies.
items.te: సర్వపిండి: బియ్యపు పిండి, శనగపప్పు, పల్లీలతో తెలంగాణ వంటకం.

items.title: Gongura pachadi
items.text: A tangy chutney from gongura (sorrel) leaves, a favourite with rice or roti.
items.te: గోంగూర పచ్చడి: పుల్లగా ఉండే ఇష్టమైన పచ్చడి.

questions.why: Ragi is finger millet, rich in calcium.

questions.q: Nuvvula undalu are made from sesame and…
questions.why: Sesame and jaggery are the main ingredients.
Roasted peanuts and jaggery give protein and energy without junk.
Jowar is a millet with good fibre.

how: Sit with your grandmother while she cooks. Write the ingredients and each step in a notebook (take photos too).
Type your notes into Gemini and ask it to arrange them into clear, numbered steps.
Read the steps back to your grandmother and correct anything she says is different.
In Canva, search 'recipe book' and choose a template. Make one page per recipe with a photo.
Add 'Why it is healthy' in one line, and 'From Ammamma's kitchen' with her name.
Download as PDF and share it with relatives and your school.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Here are my notes from watching my grandmother make jowar roti: [paste notes]. Arrange them into a simple recipe with ingredients and numbered steps in English and Telugu. Do not add ingredients that are not in my notes.
